title: Binary cube and subset correspondence
statement: For a finite index set $\iota$, the map from functions $x:\iota\to\mathbb{F}_2$ to subsets of $\iota$ sends each function to its support, the set of indices where it is nonzero. This map is an equivalence, with inverse given by the indicator function of a subset.
